description: Electricity Cables Laid by Voltage Level (RKm) is a data set listed in Qatar Open Data Portal (data.gov.qa), an open data portal (Opendatasoft), published or maintained by KAHRAMAA. This dataset details the lengths of electricity cables laid in Qatar, categorized by voltage levels including 400 kV, 220 kV, 132 kV, 66 kV, 33 kV, and 11 kV. It distinguishes cables already in service and cables commissioned. The dataset helps in tracking infrastructure development and expansion of the electrical grid network. Coverage: Qatar. The portal files it under the publisher KAHRAMAA. Its tags are cables, electricity, length, infrastructure, commissioning. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV, JSON. The portal shows 2026-06-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-qa-portal.
